title: Asking the way to the station

script.text: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
Walk straight for two blocks, then turn left.
Should I take the bus instead?
The number 4 stops across the street.

questions.question: How long is the walk?
questions.explanation: The guide says about ten minutes on foot.

questions.question: Which bus goes to the station?
How often does the bus come?
questions.explanation: The last line says every fifteen minutes until midnight.
